A vast '''lake''' lay on the site of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] overlooked the lake<ref name="RotS" /> which was in fact a geologically recent [[Asteroid/Legends|meteor]] crater.<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> It had formed around [[30,500 BBY]]<ref name="FF18">According to [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 18|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 18]], the crater formed roughly three thousands [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the arrival of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places around [[27,500 BBY]].</ref> and had subsequently filled with [[Water/Legends|water]] from the local subterranean aquifers.<ref name="ISWU" /> The [[City/Legends|city]] of Aldera itself was built on an island&mdash;or more precisely a peninsula&mdash;overlooking the lake.<ref name="LJMoD">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref> Visitors commonly reached the city by crossing the lake by boat.<ref name="ISWU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lake of Aldera was first mentioned in the [[1995]] reference book ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''. In the same book, the lake also appeared in the first picture ever depicting the city of Aldera.<ref name="ISWU" /> While the city itself was heavily redesigned for the movie [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] in [[2005]],<ref name="AoSWIII">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> the lake still appeared in it.<ref name="RotS" /> In "[[Prélude à un nouvel espoir]]," an ambiguously [[canon]]ical roleplaying adventure in the [[Wikipedia:France|French]] gaming magazine ''[[Casus Belli HS6]]'', the lake of Aldera was stated to be located south of the city.<ref name="CBHS6">{{CasusBelliCite|103|Prélude à un nouvel espoir}}</ref>
